text: The PM will check updated project requirements (teletext removal, remote usage scope for television, corporate image) and provide an update at the next meeting. Separately, the team has aligned the scope by defining the target user segments: nineteen to thirty-five, including teenagers and young professionals. Teletext was deemed outdated and off the list, with remote usage limited to television; a design approach for a silver device with yellow writing was discussed, and the rationale was linked to internet popularity. A location feature was also considered to help locate the remote, with discussions about using radio over IR and subsequent actions to document progress and complete questionnaires before the lunch break for thirty minutes of individual work.
